description: Search official job listings at Forbes Global 2000 employers by role words, company and job location. Results are compact (call get_job for a full description); company_evidence holds each employer's evidence date and coverage warnings; top_companies counts the employers with the most matches. Repeat postings (same company, title, location) are folded into repeat_postings unless show_repeats=true. Read warnings: they explain empty results and how filters were read. Location filters are where the job is, never the user's own location. Listings are observed, not confirmed open: cite official_url and dates.

city.description: City words matched in the job location text, e.g. 'Seattle'.

company.description: company_uri, or an employer name or brand such as 'Bank of America' or 'Google' (resolved when unambiguous; warnings say how).

country.description: Job country: ISO code or name, e.g. 'DE' or 'Germany'.

employment_type.description: Stated employment type. Many listings do not state one.

fresh_only.description: Only employers verified in the last 7 days.

pay_currency.description: Currency for salary filters, e.g. USD or EUR.

pay_maximum.description: Salary ceiling; ranges overlapping it match.

pay_minimum.description: Salary floor; ranges overlapping it match.

pay_period.description: Pay period for salary filters; required with pay_minimum or pay_maximum.

posted_after.description: Employer publication date floor, YYYY-MM-DD; jobs without a stated date never match.

query.description: Role or skill words, e.g. 'registered nurse'. Every word must match; only if none does are filler words dropped, then any word matched (warnings say so). Put places in city/region/country.

region.description: State or region matched in the job location text. A U.S. state code or name ('TX' or 'Texas') searches U.S. jobs only.

response_format.description: concise omits each job's summary and page_url; detailed includes them.

scope.description: us = U.S. jobs only; global = everywhere.

seniority.description: Seniority classified from the title and description. Many listings are unclassified.

show_repeats.description: List every repeat posting instead of counting them.

work_mode.description: Stated work arrangement. Most listings do not state one; leave empty unless required.

name: search_jobs

repeat_postings.description: Extra openings with the same company, title and location.

top_companies.description: Employers with the most matching postings (first page; empty when total_capped).

title: Search jobs
